author: GamingBolt
description:
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is finally here, and even if the PC version is a rigmarole-and-a-half right now, it's proving to be extremely fun. The anime aesthetic and extensive single-player modes, including All-Star Arena and Episode Mode, will keep Marvel fans busy, and you can likely get by with the most rudimentary understanding of the mechanics and what the face buttons do.

However, if you're looking to compete and excel online or delve deeper into the systems while slowly mastering each character – maybe to complete all those combo challenges – it can take some time. Fortunately, we have a few tips that should get you going and igniting the battlefield in no time.
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - 15 Things I Wish I Knew Before Playing

author: GamingBolt
description:
From its Mediterranean island setting to its fantasy driven narrative, Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is set to reimagine the storied series in several noticeable ways. Familiar themes remain - the disease, of course - but the foundations have shifted, with new ways to deliver the story supported by different environmental design and combat philosophies. 

We’ve already done a "15 Things to Know" feature, now it’s time for fifteen of the biggest differences between Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy and its predecessor A Plague Tale: Requiem, let’s get to it.

Link to our before you buy feature: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ijl15smxByc
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy vs Requiem - 15 Biggest Differences You May Not Know

author: GamingBolt
description:
Rebel Wolves hasn’t hidden the fact that many of the people who made The Witcher 3 are among its ranks. That’s placed high expectations on The Blood of Dawnwalker though, and Coen’s got some big shoes to fill as he tries to be a protagonist as iconic as gruff old Geralt of Rivia. But is his fight for the liberty of Vale Sangora, a prize he must pry from the hands of a cunning and ruthless antagonist, similar to the game that has perhaps inspired it?

We think not. To that end, we ask you to join us as we explain why this new adventure might share some familiar touches with its inspirations, but is an entirely different beast all on its own.
title: Why The Blood of Dawnwalker Won't Simply Be Another Witcher 3
